title: Fläche_side-1c
slide_intent: Use one direction to introduce a plane so a viewer can understand the transition quickly.
strategic_value: A single red horizontal wipe can carry DB recognition while leaving dense content a simple transition.
demonstration: A red plane enters from the left, fills the frame, and exits toward the right.
practical_value: Choose the one-color horizontal treatment for functional or information-dense applications.

content_islands.name: Entry
content_islands.spec: Extend the red plane from the left edge.

content_islands.name: Exit
content_islands.spec: Continue the plane along the horizontal axis until the pale field returns.

reference_purposes.Intent: Accompanying Flächenverhalten prose says clear axes and straight movement keep focus on content; two-color variants add expression for bold content.
